question: Who received the UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**La Prensa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **La Prensa**, a prominent newspaper from **Nicaragua**, received the prestigious **UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize** in **May 2025**.
 
• The award honors individuals or organizations that have made a significant contribution to the defense or promotion of **press freedom**, especially under difficult circumstances.
 
• **La Prensa** has been a vocal advocate for **press freedom** in Nicaragua, often facing challenges such as censorship, threats, and harassment from authoritarian regimes.
 
• The newspaper is recognized for its unwavering commitment to reporting the truth and holding those in power accountable, despite facing severe restrictions and risks.
 
• The UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize is named after **Guillermo Cano Isaza**, a Colombian journalist who was assassinated in **1986** for his courageous work in exposing corruption and drug cartels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize:**

 
 
• Established in **1997**, this award is given annually by **UNESCO** to recognize outstanding contributions to the defense of **press freedom worldwide**.
 
• The prize carries a monetary award of **USD 25,000**, funded by the **Guillermo Cano Isaza Foundation**, the **Colombian Association of Newspapers**, and the **Norwegian government**.
 
• The prize ceremony is held on **World Press Freedom Day**, celebrated annually on **May 3rd**.
 
 
 
• **About La Prensa:**
 
 
• **La Prensa** is one of Nicaragua's oldest and most influential newspapers, founded in **1926**.
 
• It has often faced persecution and censorship for its critical coverage of government policies and corruption.
 
• Despite hardships, the newspaper continues its mission to provide **truthful and independent journalism** to the public.
 
 
 
• **Previous Recipients:**
 
 
• Notable recipients of the UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize include **Maria Ressa** (2021), **Narges Mohammadi** (2022), and **Mazen Darwish** (2015).
 
• These individuals and organizations were recognized for their exceptional efforts in upholding **press freedom** under challenging circumstances.
 
 
 
• **Significance of World Press Freedom Day:**
 
 
• World Press Freedom Day serves as an opportunity to celebrate the fundamental principles of press freedom and raise awareness about the challenges faced by journalists worldwide.
 
• The day also highlights the importance of ensuring the safety of journalists and combating threats to independent media.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Guillermo Cano Isaza:** He was a Colombian journalist who paid the ultimate price for his fearless reporting against drug cartels and corruption. His legacy inspired the creation of this UNESCO prize.
 
• **Challenges Faced by La Prensa:** The newspaper has endured measures such as confiscation of printing materials, government intimidation, and limited access to public information.
 
• **Recognition of Press Freedom Advocates:** Awards like this highlight the crucial role journalists play in safeguarding democracy and human rights.
 
• **Impact on Global Journalism:** By honoring courageous individuals and organizations, the prize motivates journalists worldwide to continue their work despite adversity.
